title: seor: Easily Install and Load the 'seor' SEO and Developer Tools
description: The 'seor' suite bundles a set of focused R packages for search engine optimization and web-developer workflows: URL parsing, punycode and internationalized-domain conversion, public suffix list lookups, XML sitemap parsing and PageRank estimation. Loading 'seor' with a single call to library() installs and attaches all of the member packages at once, in the style of the 'tidyverse' metapackage.
